Subject: Re: [SM-DEVEL] Need a patch for saving sent messages problem

On Wed, Feb 27, 2008 at 10:50 AM, David Severance  wrote:
> A couple of questions regarding...
>
> > use a 1.4.14 snapshot
>  The problem with a snapshot from the SVN repository that I can see is
>  that it's not guaranteed to be stable or is it?

Nothing is guaranteed, of course.  Some stable releases have contained
bugs.  But generally, the SVN repo for our stable branch will usually
be better than the last stable release because it contains fixes for
any bugs in the previous releases.

> I have something like
>  22,000 users daily who would be upset if it wasn't stable. What I mean
>  by stable is that if some changes for work in progress were half checked
>  in

That never happens in our stable branch.  Only a select number of new
features are added, and they are always checked in in full.

> then I would get something unstable. Or am I over thinking / worrying
>  about it? If I check out that copy is it supposed to be ready to go,
>  just awaiting someone to call it stable? Is there a 1.4.14 release imminent?

The best thing to do in a serious production environment is test it in
a parallel installation on your own servers to guarantee its
stability.  We have not discussed a 1.4.14 release yet, but it IS more
stable than 1.4.13 already because it has a couple small but important
fixes for some compose bugs.

>  Sorry for all the worrying, I'd just like to be clear as to what I'd be
>  getting myself into.

Cheers,

  Paul
